illustration.description: Hand-drawn style cartoon illustration of a person's legs mid-stride walking to the left-to-right diagonal, wearing grey jeans with cuffed hems and bright blue low-top sneakers with white soles and laces; the front foot (left) is planted flat on the ground with a brown-tinted sole edge, the back foot (right) lifting off heel-first with small motion lines behind it; a soft pale blue motion shadow streaks along the ground beneath the feet; a few faint yellow motion tick marks near the planted foot; a trail of grey footprint shapes fades toward the upper right; subtle paper-grain texture, clean dark outlines, flat muted colors with light shading, soft off-white background, eye-level side view, crisp even lighting
